decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric with a strong fit to the firm's established design and production knowledge, it is more likely to be refined within the range than withdrawn.
Its flame-retardant curtain function matches the firm's contract-textile capabilities and absorptive capacity in performance fabrics, making retention very likely.
The fabric builds on existing decorative know-how, but as a less prominently positioned wool-blend item it still faces some rationalisation risk if demand remains only moderate.
The firm can technically develop this related leno and bouclé product further, yet its niche character and lower visibility keep withdrawal risk comparatively elevated.

This newly launched braided-structure fabric sits close to the firm's upholstery and curtain expertise, and its dedicated presentation suggests the firm will give it time and development effort rather than drop it quickly.
